title: Fix iPhone top controls and pending allocation layout
summary: iPhone safe areas now keep top controls below the status bar, while pending shared-allocation prompts use the full width of their card.
changes: Keeps Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat top controls below the iPhone status bar and Dynamic Island by preserving an additive safe-area inset on narrow screens.
Fixes the pending Labour Ward / Pager allocation prompt so its text uses the full amber card instead of collapsing into a narrow grid column.
Adds phone regression coverage for safe-area reachability and the shared-allocation prompt without changing roster, staffing, break or clock-change logic.
